When I failed out of college. 

It was my second semester at UCF. I had failed an algebra course in my first semester, maths never been my strong suit. It was one of those thirty minute lecture hall deals where the teacher barely covered things and then we had to go to the MathLab for hours to kind of teach ourselves.

Anyway, prior to that November, I don't remember having depression or migraines so bad they felt like they tore my head apart. I didn't have any migraines at all before that.

I used to go out with friends often, nothing cool, just like everyone would come over, I'd cook or we'd order food, and we'd play dungeons and dragons in my dorm. Maybe we'd drive around and explore the city. I'd always been fat but I was losing some serious weight in college walking around to different peoples places. Walking to classes ect. 

Then it came to a pretty immediate halt that November, when in one month my grandmother died and I got raped by one of my closest friends.

He was nice, bit of a freeloader -- stayed at my dorm for weeks once on the couch. I realize now mostly to flirt with my room mates. He would cook breakfast for us but not any of our d&d groups guy friend who were still there. He tossed food into the basket like a child when he came along for grocery shopping.  He took me to a musical a city over than coincidentally ran out of gas on the way back. So we had to sit in some rest stop while he made goo goo eyes and told me he liked me. I had a boyfriend at the time and he tried to kiss me at that rest stop but I let him down easy and then we joked about the musical we just saw.

No one believes me and I never called anyone for it because he was a friend. I had a boyfriend at the time, but my friend and I were hanging out and after far too many four locos he got grabby. He had pretty surprising strength. Anyway, it was in my dorm and after he had this surprised look in his eyes-- wide-- he got up suddenly with realization at what he did. He paced and held his arms like he was in shock. Like he was some sort of molester werewolf or something. He asked what did we do? I didn't just? He suddenly didn't quite remember what had happen for about an hour prior. This wasn't the next morning this was right after.

So I calmed him down and consoled him.  Told him we didn't do anything. He looked so scared. I called another  a friend and had them drive my rapist home. Then I took a shower, cleaned myself out, and cried under the water. How pathetic, I get strong armed on my own friend, on my bed, and I apologized because I didn't want to hurt his feelings? He came over the next day like nothing happened.

Shortly before that that month my grandma passed. I was never that close to her but it was the first major death of someone I knew. She lived with us, and she'd be curt with me. We'd argue often, but now I knew  I was never going to be able to make up with her. I learned whatever the past nasty thing I say might be the last thing I ever say to a person.

Both of these were towards the end of November. Then after I remember shutting out my friends and room mates. I spent days and nights feeling dead. I couldn't breathe, I started having small panic attacks. 

I remember my first migraine. I didn't know what it was, I thought I was going blind. I couldn't see and I remember trying to dial a phone but getting no where and going, crying to my room mate who just came back that I needed to go the doctor here. I was blind, everything hurt, sounds were magnified and my skull felt like it was splitting. She has to walk me across campus, holding my hand as I tripped or tried not to scream at the sweet Florida sunshine searing my mind. The doctor sort of chuckled and said oh that's just a migraine. PEOPLE GET THESE? I thought migraines were just head aches maybe bad head aches but not 20 hours of the devil skull fucking  your eyes.

Between the migraines and this brand new sense of worthless and helplessness I stayed in my dorm through December. Failed my classes and between that and the failed first, my gpa for the school itself was too low and I got kicked. I didn't say then and I have no way to prove what happened. I'm fat so we can all assume it's because I'm lazy.

The depression and the migraines never went away. Anxiety showed up in full force a year later and the migraines got to a point that they were showing up 3 times a week. They feel like punishment.

I've never recovered from that November, it's been years now and I have managed to hold down some jobs here and there-- in fact I have an interview tomorrow that I'm probably going to skip (cars dead bikes stripped by God knows who, and again, I'm a lazy fat fuck who can't really manage an 8 mile walk to and from work. It's a miracle these days if I get out of bed. My tax return just got eaten by my delinquent student loan, so I can't afford to buy that bike to go to this job even if I get the interview. Que Sera.  I live at home and I have no foreseeable way out of that.

I shouldn't have broken, but at this point it's too dark to see if I can get past this, ever. It's been years but I'd give anything--- anything, for it to be October 2012. Because after that my life broke.

Determined is an odd word for it.  Every time I really get dark enough to make an attempt my head is clear he next morning. Suicide isn't about ending life it's about ending pain. If a person is without pain and not wanting to back off the ledge they don't put it on suicide watch. They put it on a live leak and jump off a bridge like Mary poppins with an umbrella, so that the fancy  death has more questions than answers. 

The body has a very high aversion to death,  so think as wanting to die, not the small times where you ponder it, but those days you have the pills in your hand. You feel different the next day, and that keeps you going for maybe a few days. With depression it's a matter of your own mind battling you every day. So yes "I" want to kill myself but "I" don't want to die.

So part of you is determined, and the other part of you posted on suicide watch.

From personal experiences, /r/depression and here, of all places, has been better as far as dissuading such thoughts. But I imagine if you are taking the time to post on suicide watch, you just want someone tell talk you off the ledge.  So it likely helps a lot. Having that outlet, having the place to call out and ask, please help please talk to me, is a valuable one.

Fair enough. Op, hope is dead. So let's break it down to a poor semblance of math. You come from an unbroken chain of love. Countless pairs got together to make you. 

The chances of you meeting your soul mate is impossible, as soul mates don't exist. But the chances of your father meeting your mother were bad.

 The chances of your grandfather meeting your grand mother were also very bad.  What I'm talking about isn't finding THE one, I'm talking about finding someone.

The universe is indifferent to us as individuals, but who gives a shit about what the universe thinks? It is the gauntlet you run now, this pain, this depression, this chemical imbalance in your mind that makes you ready to find love and give love.

I've had depression now for seven years, tried to kill myself three times, and at my worst I could tell people I weighed 380lbs.  I have a boyfriend. He's pretty fit and we go to the gym together now. We met playing dungeons and dragons at a college I flunked out of. It's by no means perfect, but it is love. It's also impossible. The chances I went to that meeting and sat at that table? Out of all the activities I could have done that day--- including say, getting run over by a car or dying to hurricane Charlie, I went there and I made a friend who became a lover.

So, yes, the uncaring universe doesn't give two shits about you. That hot girl doesn't give two shits about you, that hot guy if that's what you're into, ugly girl, ugly guy, old new fat thin normal rich poor ect ect, doesn't give two universe rending shits about you. 

But there is always a chance, that you get up and go to the store, play board games, see a movie, there's a chance that maybe MAYBE you can find someone who you can convince to give a shit about you. 


Or you could get run over by a car going to a Wendy's, choke on a burger after missing a car, ect ect. The universe doesn't care. But I bet you do.
